title: The Sure to Rise Cookery Book Is Especially Compiled, and Contains Useful, Everyday Recipes, also Cooking Hints
summary: "The Sure to Rise Cookery Book" by T.J. Edmonds Ltd. is a recipe book first published in 1908 as a marketing tool for baking powder. Originally featuring just 50 pages, this New Zealand cookbook evolved through numerous editions, adapting to changing kitchen technology and tastes. With over three million copies sold, it became the best-selling New Zealand published book and a national icon, described as essential to Kiwi kitchens as a stove itself.
